reasons: Correct option is directly traceable to the cited EPA statement about aeration and mixing preventing solids deposition and maintaining aerobic basin conditions.
Item is framed explicitly as general technical background and not as an Ontario or universal legal requirement, consistent with the source boundary for flow equalization.

requiredChanges: Minor wording adjustment could further reduce any perceived prescriptive tone, for example by reinforcing that mixing is typically used to help prevent solids deposition and maintain more uniform conditions rather than implying it is always required.
